courses.title: Structured Programming Language
courses.content: Introduction to programming concepts, control structures, functions, arrays, pointers, and structures in C.

courses.title: Structured Programming Language Lab
courses.content: Laboratory sessions for Structured Programming Language (C programming).

courses.title: Discrete Mathematics
courses.content: Sets, logic, relations, functions, graphs, trees, combinatorics, and algebraic structures.

courses.title: Digital Logic Design
courses.content: Number systems, Boolean algebra, logic gates, combinational and sequential circuit design.

courses.title: Object Oriented Programming
courses.content: Object-oriented principles, classes, objects, inheritance, polymorphism, templates, and exception handling in C++.

courses.title: Object Oriented Programming Lab
courses.content: Hands-on lab in OOP using C++.

courses.title: Data Structures
courses.content: Arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, graphs, hashing, sorting, and searching algorithms.

courses.title: Data Structures Lab
courses.content: Hands-on implementation of core data structures.

courses.title: Database Management Systems
courses.content: Introduction to databases, SQL, relational algebra, normalization, transactions, indexing, and NoSQL databases.

courses.title: Database Management Systems Lab
courses.content: Hands-on lab exercises in SQL programming, database schema design, and backend database connectivity.

courses.title: Software Engineering
courses.content: Software development lifecycles, Agile/Scrum, software design patterns, testing, UML modeling, and DevOps practices.

courses.title: Software Engineering Lab
courses.content: Practical team project designing, developing, and deploying a modern web/mobile application.

courses.title: Computer Networks
courses.content: Network architecture, OSI model layers, TCP/IP protocol suite, routing algorithms, socket programming, and security.

courses.title: Computer Networks Lab
courses.content: Network configuration, packet analysis using Wireshark, socket programming, and Cisco packet tracer labs.

courses.title: Operating Systems
courses.content: Processes, threads, CPU scheduling, synchronization, deadlocks, memory management, and file systems.

courses.title: Operating Systems Lab
courses.content: Shell scripting, system call programming, CPU scheduling algorithm simulation, and thread synchronization.

courses.title: Theory of Computation
courses.content: Finite automata, regular expressions, context-free grammars, Turing machines, and computational complexity.

courses.title: Microprocessors & Assembly Language
courses.content: 8086 architecture, assembly language programming, memory interfacing, and hardware peripherals.
